answer: Each agent plants a lotus identity in the canyon registry and pays a dawn tax of 40 credits each epoch. The tax scales: the kth identity from one key pays 40 times k, so the 1,000th costs 40,000 and 1,000 fakes pay 20,020,000 per epoch, against a 40,000 pool. A rented-tax ring fails: the canyon ledger lists every funder key, and skipping the dawn payment burns the lotus bond. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its share.
